SELECT V. ID AS VISITORID, V.VISITOR_NAME, V.VISITOR_PHOTO_ID, V.STATUS, V.CAUSE, V.START_TIME, V.END_TIME, P.PARK_NAME PARKNAME, V.PARK_ID, V.CREATE_TIME FROM SMT_VISITOR V INNER JOIN SMT_PARK P ON V.PARK_ID=P.ID
AND V.RECEPTIONIST_BADGE =#{query.receptionistBadge} AND TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(V.END_TIME, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss'),'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') >= TO_DATE(#{query.endTime}, 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AND V.PROMOTER_BADGE IS NULL
AND V.PROMOTER_BADGE =#{query.promoterBadge} AND V.CREATE_TIME between to_date(#{query.startTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') and to_date(#{query.endTime},'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss')
AND V.STATUS !=#{query.status}
ORDER BY V.CREATE_TIME DESC

ID AS RECEPTIONISTID, S. NAME AS RECEPTIONISTNAME, S.BADGE AS RECEPTIONISTNUMBER, S.COMP_NAME AS RECEPTIONISTBU, S.DEP_NAME AS RECEPTIONISTDEPT, S.JOB_NAME AS RECEPTIONISTJOB, S.JCHE_NAME AS RECEPTIONISTJCHENAME, S.PHONE AS RECEPTIONISTPHONE, V.VISITOR_FRONT_PHOTO_ID AS VISITORFRONTPHOTOID , V.VISITOR_BACK_PHOTO_ID AS VISITORBACKPHOTOID, V.REMARK, P.PARK_NAME AS PAKRNAME , V.PARK_ID AS PARKID, V.CREATE_TIME, V.CERT_TYPE FROM SMT_VISITOR V LEFT JOIN SMT_STAFF S ON V.RECEPTIONIST_BADGE = S.BADGE LEFT JOIN SMT_PARK P ON V.PARK_ID=P.ID
V.ID =#{query.id}

SELECT V.
